token.label: Token
token.description: The API token from Bika (My Settings > Developer).

space_id.label: Space
space_id.description: The Bika space that holds the database.

maxRecords.label: Max Records
maxRecords.description: How many records to return in total (default 100, at most 1,000).

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: How many records to fetch per API request (default 100, at most 1,000). Larger pages use fewer of your Bika API requests.

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Only return records that match, for example {Stage}=="Close Deals";{Score}>10. Put field names with spaces in {}, join conditions with ; (and) or , (or). See https://bika.ai/help/guide/developer/filter-query-language.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: To continue a previous search, paste the offset it returned. Leave empty to start from the first record.

bika_find_record.label: Get Record
bika_find_record.description: Retrieves a record in database by ID.

space_id.label: Space
space_id.description: The Bika space that holds the database.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: The ID of the record to get (starts with "rec").

bika_delete_record.label: Delete Record
bika_delete_record.description: Deletes a record in database by ID.

space_id.label: Space
space_id.description: The Bika space that holds the database.

recordId.label: Record ID
recordId.description: The ID of the record to delete (starts with "rec").

list_spaces.label: List Spaces
list_spaces.description: Lists the Bika spaces this account belongs to.

list_databases_by_id.label: List Databases
list_databases_by_id.description: Lists the databases in a space.

space_id.label: Space ID
space_id.description: The space ID (starts with "spc"). Use List Spaces to find it.

get_database_fields_by_id.label: Get Database Fields
get_database_fields_by_id.description: Lists the fields (columns) of a database.

space_id.label: Space ID
space_id.description: The space ID (starts with "spc"). Use List Spaces to find it.

database_id.label: Database ID
database_id.description: The database ID (starts with "dat"). Use List Databases to find it.

get_record_by_id.label: Get Record (by ID)
get_record_by_id.description: Gets one record by its ID.

space_id.label: Space ID
space_id.description: The space ID (starts with "spc"). Use List Spaces to find it.

database_id.label: Database ID
database_id.description: The database ID (starts with "dat"). Use List Databases to find it.

delete_record_by_id.label: Delete Record (by ID)
delete_record_by_id.description: Permanently deletes a record by its ID.

space_id.description: The space ID (starts with "spc"). Use List Spaces to find it.
